title: DOS Distribution Synthesizer Variables
description: Configuration variables controlling T3 FreeDOS and MIT MS-DOS sysroot staging, shell selection, and rootless FAT12/FAT16/FAT32 media packing.

LIBSCRIPT_DOS_VERSION.description: Target FreeDOS (1.3, 1.4) or MIT MS-DOS (1.25, 2.0, 4.0) release version.

LIBSCRIPT_DOS_STRATUM.description: Active DOS capability stratum (dos32-dpmi, dos16-handle, or dos16-fcb).

LIBSCRIPT_DOS_SHELL_PROVIDER.description: Command shell provider configured in CONFIG.SYS (default, win-cmd-asm, win-cmd-rs, freecom, or msdos-command).

LIBSCRIPT_DOS_MEDIA_TYPE.description: FAT media layout (auto, floppy-360k, floppy-720k, floppy-1440k, hdd-fat16, or hdd-fat32).
